# Health Leaders

This folder contains profiles of individuals in senior leadership and administrative roles within Danish healthcare quality initiatives. It documents the chief physicians and committee chairs who guide the strategic direction, cross-regional quality measurement, and standardized reporting for national databases like DANIBD, with every professional affiliation and administrative action traced back to the original annual reports.

## Pages

- [[lone-larsen|Lone Larsen]] — Chief physician, PhD, and chair of the DANIBD steering committee who oversees the national quality monitoring of inflammatory bowel disease treatments in Denmark.
